# Directory operator controls — October 26, 2026

User direction: keep the existing designs, remove the separate settings UI, reuse native CMS controls, fit many suites on one screen with automatic text resizing, support exact automatic page capacities, and make every visible word editable. No Astra delegation is used for this update.

The existing PropertiesPanel controls now render directory settings directly. Normal rows contain only name and suite/room. Display offers a single screen or automatic pages; paging shows capacity, while transition, seconds and a named speed remain visible and saved on single-screen directories too. Building photo is always visible above the directory fields and uses the existing asset picker. Appearance keeps the logo and three color controls collapsed. Pages & rotation includes Make 2 pages, which splits the current list and exposes automatic capacity. Saved transition/timing stay visible, with explicit left/right and up/down choices, including continuous scroll in both vertical directions. Seconds per page stays visible for all choices and controls continuous travel time too; regular page changes also have a named animation speed. The CMS Preview plays the rotation; no embedded hover menu covers the directory. Copy editing is contextual through the standard canvas protocol, with a selector for restoring cleared text.

Adaptive directory rows deliberately permit fonts below the earlier 60px default, per the user's explicit requirement. Fitting preserves all names/suites and checks their actual bounds. Other widgets retain their existing standards. A new Corporate Large Building template demonstrates 100 fictional tenants on a full-width ledger in both 4K orientations.

Legacy customer documents are preserved. Generic text overrides are folded into the structured document before the simple editor clears stale copy keys. Deployment changes the shared renderer and native editor; the additive installer only creates missing preset/custom records and writes audit evidence.
